_about: Structured index of every experiment, read by the dashboard (/experiments). experiments/LOG.md is the written record; keep both in step. status: planned | running | collecting | live | shipped | not_shipped | done. Metrics are on validation years unless a key says test.
test_looks_note: E001, E002, E011 + 2 diagnostic calibration checks during the 2026-10-06 review

benchmark.label: ATP validation 2020–2022, log loss (lower is better)

experiments.title: sharp_v1 live: best bookmaker price vs Pinnacle's fair price
experiments.hypothesis: E011 found a real price edge in EPL history (beat Pinnacle's close on train and test) but too few bets to judge profit. Our morning odds cover ~19 bookmakers per match for tennis and football, so the same rule can be tested live on many more matches.
experiments.change: sharp_v1: probability = Pinnacle's price with the margin removed; bet the best real bookmaker quote (exchanges excluded) when it pays ≥ 2% more than fair. Quarter-Kelly, 5% cap, fresh $5,000 wallet per sport. Needs no model, so it also bets matches our Elo can't price.
experiments.protocol: Live only (no test-year look). Judge = CLV against Pinnacle's no-vig CLOSING price (ATP: our snapshots ≤ 3h before the start; EPL: football-data's Pinnacle close). min_edge 2% instead of E011's 5%: the 2% variant also beat the close on train (+5.0%) and roughly doubles the sample.

progress.metric: settled bets with a Pinnacle close

rules.text: After 150 settled bets: keep if mean CLV vs Pinnacle's fair close > 0 with a 95% CI above 0
Stop if the CI is entirely below 0
Otherwise extend once to 300 bets and decide on the point estimate

followups: Tennis backtest on tennis-data.co.uk files (owner download)

experiments.title: Sharp vs soft: bet mainstream books that beat Pinnacle's fair price
experiments.hypothesis: Pinnacle (the sharpest bookmaker) with its margin removed is close to the true probability. Mainstream books are slower and sometimes pay more than that fair price: no model needed, the edge is the disagreement between bookmakers.
experiments.change: Fair p = Pinnacle opening price / margin. Bet the outcome with the largest fair p × best mainstream price − 1 if ≥ 5% (chosen on train), quarter-Kelly, 5% cap. EPL only (tennis needs tennis-data.co.uk files).
experiments.protocol: Train 2012/13–2021/22 (8 variants: soft/max price × min edge 1/2/3/5%), one look at 2022/23–now. CLV = bet odds × Pinnacle no-vig closing p − 1.

rules.text: Train: CLV > 0, 95% CI excludes 0 (+7.45% [+6.2, +8.8])
Test: flat ROI > 0 and wallet ends above $1,000 (−28.7%, $957)
Test: ≥ 100 bets (90)

experiments.verdict: Real price edge (positive CLV on train and test, unlike every model so far: elo_v0 −5.5%), but the bets are longshots (mean odds ~13) so 90 test bets prove nothing about profit (9.6 wins expected, 7 happened), and opportunities shrank (3 in 2025/26 so far). Failed R3/R4, not shipped; candidate for a live paper forward test judged on CLV.
followups: Live paper forward test (sharp_v1) on our own quotes, judged on CLV
Tennis version on tennis-data.co.uk files (owner download)

experiments.title: Favourite–longshot bias in qualifying and challenger markets
experiments.hypothesis: Below the main tour, favourites win more often than their odds imply (I002: +1.1 pts in ATP qualifying, +1.7 in challenger qualifying). With ratings that cover those players (E009), betting selected favourites may beat the higher margin.
experiments.change: Not designed yet: E009's ratings now cover qualifying and challenger players; backtest on the tennisdata.app challenger/qualifying odds (2021–2026).

experiments.title: Tennis on TennisMyLife data: better Elo + daily forecaster
experiments.hypothesis: Ratings fed by challengers and qualifying, shrunk after long absences, fix the errors I002 found; E006's forecaster rebuilt on data that is current every day can run live.
experiments.change: (a) TennisElo on TML player IDs fed by main tour + challengers + qualifying (chosen of 18 variants: no shrink after absences, k_scale 200). (b) Gradient boosting (scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting, depth 2, 258 trees, chosen of 16) on (a)'s Elo + ranking, form, rest, format and decayed serve/return rates.
experiments.protocol: Scored against elo_v0 on the same ATP main-tour rows of our odds data. 18 Elo variants + 16 forecaster variants on train years.

rules.text: (a) log loss beats elo_v0 on 2020–22, 95% tournament-bootstrap CI excludes 0
(a) better than elo_v0 in ≥ 2 of 3 validation years
(a) wallet ROI (live rules) not worse than elo_v0
(b) shown on the dashboard if it beats (a) with the CI excluding 0
(b) bets only if it also beats elo_v0's wallet ROI

experiments.verdict: Best forecaster yet (0.6019 log loss, 66.1% accuracy; +0.022/match over elo_v0, better every year), now live on the dashboard as forecast_p. Not a betting strategy: both models lost more in the backtest wallet (−14.0% / −15.3% vs −8.1%). Challenger and qualifying results helped most; shrinking ratings after absences hurt in every variant. Note: a first run scored the wallet on rows out of date order and wrongly showed a pass; fixed before any decision.

experiments.title: Timing and closing line value from our own odds snapshots
experiments.hypothesis: If an edge exists it is in timing: early prices may be softer than closing ones, and prices may drift toward Elo before the start.
experiments.change: Every odds response is saved (state/odds_snapshots.csv); extra ATP snapshots at 06:00 and 12:00 UTC with a credit guard. Closing = last snapshot ≤ 180 min before the start.
experiments.protocol: experiments/e008_timing.py: open vs close log loss, share of price moves toward Elo, CLV per wallet.

rules.text: Judge only after 150 usable events and 150 ATP bets
Prices move toward Elo in > 55% of moves (binomial p < 0.05)
elo_v0's mean CLV 95% CI above 0

experiments.title: News veto: never back a player with injury news
experiments.hypothesis: Elo knows nothing about fitness. Skipping bets on players with fresh injury, illness or withdrawal news avoids losers the market may not have fully priced.
experiments.change: news_v1 = elo_v0, except it never backs an ATP player whose news label (Google News, last 7 days, labelled by an LLM via OpenRouter) is injured / ill / withdrawn / doubt with confidence ≥ 0.6.
experiments.protocol: Live only (no history of news). Compare vetoed picks' results with what elo_v0 expected; log loss of elo_p vs market on flagged vs unflagged forecasts.

rules.text: Judge after ≥ 50 vetoed elo_v0 bets
Vetoed picks' P&L negative with a 90% CI below 0 → keep, then fit a probability adjustment per label

experiments.title: XGBoost + serve/return stats (Sackmann)
experiments.hypothesis: How a player wins points (serve and return quality) carries information Elo-based features miss.
experiments.change: E005's XGBoost plus decayed serve/return rates per player (Sackmann 2008–2024, all levels).
experiments.protocol: Fit 2010–17, choose on 2018–19 (16 variants), refit 2010–19, score 2020–22 once.

rules.text: Beats E005 with the 95% CI excluding 0
Better in ≥ 2 of 3 validation years
Wallet ROI not worse than elo_v0

experiments.verdict: Best forecaster so far, but a blend with the bookmaker gives it ~zero weight (0.5840 vs 0.5841): public stats are already priced in. Data ended in 2024, so it could not run live.

experiments.title: XGBoost on pre-match ATP features
experiments.hypothesis: Gradient-boosted trees on Elo, ranking, form and rest beat Elo calibrated per format.
experiments.change: XGBoost on E003's features + Elo log-odds + format, mirrored rows, symmetric predictions.
experiments.protocol: Fit 2010–17, choose on 2018–19 (16 variants), refit 2010–19, score 2020–22 once.

rules.text: Beats calibrated Elo with the 95% CI excluding 0
Better in ≥ 2 of 3 validation years
Wallet ROI not worse than elo_v0

experiments.verdict: Better probabilities, bigger losses: with no new information our disagreements with the market are mostly our errors.

experiments.title: Format-aware calibration of tennis Elo
experiments.hypothesis: Elo is overconfident in best-of-3 only; a calibration curve with its own slope for best-of-5 fixes it.
experiments.change: p' = sigmoid(slope_format × logit(p)) on top of elo_v0, one slope for best-of-3 and one for best-of-5.
experiments.protocol: Walk-forward 2017–2022 (fit on 2010…Y−1, score Y), tournament bootstrap.

rules.text: 95% CI of improvement vs raw Elo excludes 0
Better in ≥ 4 of 6 walk-forward years
Best-of-3 calibration gap under 2 pts, best-of-5 no worse

experiments.metrics_note: Walk-forward 2017–2022 pooled (13,771 matches), not the 2020–22 benchmark.
experiments.verdict: The format effect is real (+0.0051/match, 6/6 years) but the best-of-3 gap stayed at 2.6 pts: Elo grows more overconfident every year, so a curve fitted on all past years lags.

experiments.title: Decision tree on ATP pre-match features
experiments.hypothesis: Find the variable that best splits winners from losers, then split, split, split.
experiments.change: Decision tree on Elo gap, surface Elo, ranking, points, form, experience, rest, format, surface.
experiments.verdict: Exploration. Elo gap carries 86% of the tree's importance; the tree only matches calibrated Elo.

experiments.title: Hand-downloaded tennisdata.app odds + tennisabstract Elo
experiments.hypothesis: Do these sources give timing information, softer markets, or a better view of our ratings?
experiments.protocol: Market-only and rating-vs-rating comparisons; no model, no test years.
experiments.verdict: tennisdata.app odds = Kaggle's price (no timing info) but add 55k challenger/qualifying odds. Our Elo overrates long-absent players and misrates challenger-level players.

experiments.title: Data and execution integrity
experiments.hypothesis: Misresolved identities, synthetic prices and silent voids invalidate experiments.
experiments.change: Identity gate, append-only forecasts/outcomes/closing, real execution quotes, unresolved instead of void, deposits tracking, smoke test.

experiments.title: Blend Elo into the market probability
experiments.hypothesis: Starting from the market and nudging toward Elo keeps the market's accuracy while finding value.
experiments.change: p = market + w × (elo − market), w ∈ {0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5} × min edge {3%, 5%}.
experiments.verdict: Log loss worse at every w > 0; every wallet lost (ROI −7% to −74%). Elo has no information the odds lack.

experiments.title: Elo v0 baseline
experiments.hypothesis: Tuned Elo plus quarter-Kelly finds value against the bookmaker.
experiments.change: EPL k=15, home advantage 40, carryover 0.9 · ATP k_scale 200, surface weight 0.5; +5% min edge live.
experiments.verdict: Loses to the market; claimed edges are mostly overconfidence on underdogs. Live as the control group every later version must beat.
